test_title: PYST 6: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: **Select the correct spelt word.**
solution:
The correct spelling is 'Procedure'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Precipetation, Labaling , and Precoutions** do not exist in the English language.
 
• So, we can say that there are **spelling mistakes** in these words.
 
• **Procedure **is a correct English word and means an established or official way of doing something.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The correct spelling of the other three options given below along with their meanings -
 
 
• **Precipitation - **rain, snow, sleet, or hail that falls to or condenses on the ground.
 
• **Labeling - **attach a label to (something).
 
• **Precautions - **a measure is taken in advance to prevent something dangerous, unpleasant, or inconvenient from happening.
